context.title: The Family of Judah
context.summary: After listing Jacob's twelve sons, the Chronicler traces the tribe of Judah in detail, including the line from Judah to Jesse and David and the extended clans of Caleb and Jerahmeel.
context.background: Judah comes first, though not Jacob's firstborn, because Israel's kings came from Judah (5:1-2). The list includes uncomfortable names: Tamar, Achar (Achan), and an Egyptian servant who married into the family (vv. 34–35). Bezaleel (v. 20) is the craftsman who built the tabernacle.

customs.note: A spelling of Achan that plays on the Hebrew word for 'trouble,' recalling his sin at Jericho and the Valley of Achor.

watchFor: David is listed as Jesse's seventh son (v. 15); 1 Samuel 16:10-11 suggests eight sons.
The line from Judah to David matches the end of Ruth (vv. 10–15).

w: and he put to death him

people.name: Reuben
people.summary: Behold a son!, the eldest son of Jacob and Leah (Gen. 29:32). His sinful conduct, referred to in Gen. 35:22, brought down upon him his dying father’s malediction (48:4).

people.name: Levi
people.summary: The third son of Jacob by Leah. The origin of the name is found in Leah’s words (Gen. 29:34), “This time will my husband be joined [Heb. yillaveh] unto me.”

people.name: Zebulun
people.summary: Dwelling, the sixth and youngest son of Jacob and Leah (Gen. 30:20). Little is known of his personal history.

people.name: Simeon
people.summary: The second son of Jacob by Leah (Gen. 29:33). He was associated with Levi in the terrible act of vengeance against Hamor and the Shechemites (34:25, 26).

people.name: Issachar
people.summary: Hired (Gen. 30:18). “God hath given me,” said Leah, “my hire (Heb. sekhari)...and she called his name Issachar.” He was Jacob’s ninth son, and was born in Padan-aram (comp. 28:2).

people.name: Joseph
people.summary: The elder of the two sons of Jacob by Rachel (Gen. 30:23, 24), who, on the occasion of his birth, said, “God hath taken away [Heb. ‘asaph] my reproach.”

people.name: Benjamin
people.summary: The younger son of Jacob by Rachel (Gen. 35:18). His birth took place at Ephrath, on the road between Bethel and Bethlehem, at a short distance from the latter place.

people.name: Dan
people.summary: The fifth son of Jacob. His mother was Bilhah, Rachel’s maid (Gen. 30:6, “God hath judged me”, Heb. dananni).

people.name: Gad
people.summary: Jacob’s seventh son, by Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid, and the brother of Asher (Gen. 30:11-13; 46:16, 18).

people.name: Naphtali
people.summary: My wrestling, the fifth son of Jacob. His mother was Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid (Gen. 30:8). When Jacob went down into Egypt, Naphtali had four sons (Gen. 46:24).

people.name: Asher
people.summary: Happy, Jacob’s eigth son; his mother was Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid (Gen. 30:13). Of the tribe founded by him nothing is recorded beyond its holding a place in the list of the tribes (35:26; 46:17; Ex. 1:4, etc.) It increased in numbers twenty-nine percent, during the thirty-eight years’ wanderings.

people.name: Shelah
people.summary: Judah’s third son (Gen. 38:2, 5, 11, 14).

people.name: Er
people.summary: Birth.

people.name: Onan
people.summary: Strong, the second son of Judah (Gen. 38:4-10; comp. Deut. 25:5; Matt. 22:24).

people.name: Shuah
people.summary: A Canaanite whose daughter was married to Judah (1 Chr. 2:3).

people.name: Pharez
people.summary: Pharez,, breach, the son of Judah (Neh. 11:4). “The chief of all the captains of the host for the first month” in the reign of David was taken from his family (1 Chr. 27:3).

people.name: Zerah
people.summary: A son of Tamar (Gen. 38:30); called also Zara (Matt. 1:3).

people.name: Tamar
people.summary: The daughter-in-law of Judah, to whose eldest son, Er, she was married (Gen. 38:6). After her husband’s death, she was married to Onan, his brother (8), and on his death, Judah promised to her that his third son, Shelah, would become her husband.

people.name: Hezron
people.summary: The older of the two sons of Pharez (Gen. 46:12).

people.name: Hamul
people.summary: Spared, one of the sons of Pharez, son of Judah (1 Chr. 2:5).

people.name: Zabdi
people.summary: An ancestor of Achan (Josh. 7:1, 17, 18).

people.name: Calcol
people.summary: (1 Chr. 2:6), sustenance, the same probably as Chalcol (1 Kings 4:31), one of the four sages whom Solomon excelled in wisdom; for “he was wiser than all men.”

people.name: Heman
people.summary: 1 Kings 4:31; 1 Chr. 2:6, a son of Zerah, noted for his wisdom.

people.name: Achan
people.summary: Called also Achar, i.e., one who troubles (1 Chr. 2:7), in commemoration of his crime, which brought upon him an awful destruction (Josh. 7:1).

people.name: Carmi
people.summary: The son of Zimri, and the father of Achan (Josh. 7:1), “the troubler of Israel.”

people.name: Azariah
people.summary: Son of Ethan, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr. 2:8).

people.name: Caleb
people.summary: One of the three sons of Hezron of the tribe of Judah. He is also called Chelubai (1 Chr. 2:9).

people.name: Jerahmeel
people.summary: The son of Hezron, the brother of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:9, 25, 26, etc.).

people.name: Ram
people.summary: The son of Hezron, and one of the ancestors of the royal line (Ruth 4:19).

people.name: Amminadab
people.summary: The father of Nahshon, who was chief of the tribe of Judah (Num. 1:7; 2:3; 7:12, 17; 10:14).

people.name: Nahshon
people.summary: Sorcerer, the son of Aminadab, and prince of the children of Judah at the time of the first numbering of the tribes in the wilderness (Ex. 6:23).

people.name: Boaz
people.summary: The husband of Ruth, a wealthy Bethlehemite. By the “levirate law” the duty devolved on him of marrying Ruth the Moabitess (Ruth 4:1-13).

people.name: Salmon
people.summary: Shady; or Zalmon, a hill covered with dark forests, south of Shechem, from which Abimelech and his men gathered wood to burn that city (Judg. 9:48).

people.name: Jesse
people.summary: Firm, or a gift, a son of Obed, the son of Boaz and Ruth (Ruth 4:17, 22; Matt. 1:5, 6; Luke 3:32). He was the father of eight sons, the youngest of whom was David (1 Sam. 17:12).

people.name: Obed
people.summary: A son of Boaz and Ruth (Ruth 4:21, 22), and the grandfather of David (Matt. 1:5).

people.name: Eliab
people.summary: Son of Kohath.

people.name: Shammah
people.summary: One of the sons of Jesse (1 Sam. 16:9).

people.name: Abinadab
people.summary: The second of the eight sons of Jesse (1 Sam. 16:8).

people.name: Nethaneel
people.summary: One of David’s brothers (1 Chr. 2:14).

people.name: David
people.summary: Beloved, the eighth and youngest son of Jesse, a citizen of Bethlehem. His father seems to have been a man in humble life. His mother’s name is not recorded.

people.name: Ozem
people.summary: One of David’s brothers; the sixth son of Jesse (1 Chr. 2:15).

people.name: Joab
people.summary: One of the three sons of Zeruiah, David’s sister, and “captain of the host” during the whole of David’s reign (2 Sam. 2:13; 10:7; 11:1; 1 Kings 11:15).

people.name: Zeruiah
people.summary: Stricken of the Lord, David’s sister, and the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel (1 Chr. 2:16), who were the three leading heroes of David’s army, and being his nephews, they were admitted to the closest companionship with him.

people.name: Abishai
people.summary: Father of (i.e., “desirous of”) a gift, the eldest son of Zeruiah, David’s sister. He was the brother of Joab and Asahel (2 Sam. 2:18; 1 Chr. 2:16).

people.name: Asahel
people.summary: Made by God, the youngest son of Zeruiah, David’s sister. He was celebrated for his swiftness of foot. When fighting against Ish-bosheth at Gibeon, in the army of his brother Joab, he was put to death by Abner, whom he pursued from the field of battle (2 Sam. 2:18, 19).

people.name: Abigail
people.summary: The sister of David, and wife of Jether an Ishmaelite (1 Chr. 2:16, 17).

people.name: Amasa
people.summary: The son of Abigail, a sister of king David (1 Chr. 2:17; 2 Sam. 17:25).

people.name: Jether
people.summary: The father of Amasa, David’s general (1 Kings 2:5, 32); called Ithra (2 Sam. 17:25).

people.name: Azubah
people.summary: The wife of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:18, 19).

people.name: Ardon
people.summary: Descendant, the last of the three sons of Caleb by his first wife Azubah (1 Chr. 2:18).

people.name: Jesher
people.summary: Uprightness, the first of the three sons of Caleb by Azubah (1 Chr. 2:18).

people.name: Shobab
people.summary: One of the sons of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:18), the son of Hezron.

people.name: Hur
people.summary: The husband of Miriam, Moses’ sister (Ex. 17:10-12). He was associated with Aaron in charge of the people when Moses was absent on Sinai (Ex. 24:14).

people.name: Ephratah
people.summary: The second wife of Caleb, the son of Hezron, mother of Hur, and grandmother of Caleb, who was one of those that were sent to spy the land (1 Chr. 2:19, 50).

people.name: Bezaleel
people.summary: In the shadow of God; i.e., “under his protection”, the artificer who executed the work of art in connection with the tabernacle in the wilderness (Ex. 31:2; 35:30).

people.name: Uri
people.summary: Tribe of Judah.

people.name: Machir
people.summary: Manasseh’s oldest son (Josh. 17:1), or probably his only son (see 1 Chr. 7:14, 15; comp. Num. 26:29-33; Josh. 13:31). His descendants are referred to under the name of Machirites, being the offspring of Gilead (Num. 26:29).

people.name: Gilead
people.summary: Son of Manasseh.

people.name: Segub
people.summary: A descendant of Judah (1 Chr. 2:21, 22).

people.name: Jair
people.summary: Was the son of Segub of the tribe of Judah – Segub being a son of Hezron who married a daughter of Machir.

people.name: Hezron
people.summary: One of the sons of Reuben (Gen. 46:9; Ex. 6:14).

people.name: Ram
people.summary: One of the sons of Jerahmeel (1 Chr. 2:25, 27).

people.name: Ahijah
people.summary: One of the five sons of Jerahmeel, who was great-grandson of Judah (1 Chr. 2:25).

people.name: Oren
people.summary: Ash or pine, the son of Jerahmeel (1 Chr. 2:25).

people.name: Ozem
people.summary: A son of Jerahmeel (1 Chr. 2:25).

people.name: Jamin
people.summary: The sons of Ram.

people.name: Abishur
people.summary: Father of the wall; i.e., “mason”, one of the two sons of Shammai of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr. 2:28, 29).

people.name: Nadab
people.summary: One of the sons of Shammai in the tribe of Judah (1 Chr. 2:28, 30).

people.name: Shammai
people.summary: Son of Onam.

people.name: Ahlai
people.summary: Son of Sheshan.

people.name: Ishi
people.summary: Father of Sheshan.

people.name: Jonathan
people.summary: Son of Israel.

people.name: Jether
people.summary: 1 Chr. 2:32; one of Judah’s posterity.

people.name: Peleth
people.summary: One of the sons of Jonathan (1 Chr. 2:33).

people.name: Zaza
people.summary: Plenty, a descendant of Judah (1 Chr. 2:33).

people.name: Attai
people.summary: Servant of jarha and his wife.

people.name: Zabad
people.summary: Ephraimite.

people.name: Nathan
people.summary: A prophet in the reigns of David and Solomon (2 Chr. 9:29). He is first spoken of in connection with the arrangements David made for the building of the temple (2 Sam. 7:2, 3, 17), and next appears as the reprover of David on account of his sin with Bathsheba (12:1-14).

people.name: Azariah
people.summary: Jehu.

people.name: Jehu
people.summary: The son of Obed, and father of Azariah (1 Chr. 2:38).

people.name: Eleasah
people.summary: One of the descendants of Judah, of the family of Hezron (1 Chr. 2:39, “Eleasah”).

people.name: Helez
people.summary: One of Judah’s posterity (1 Chr. 2:39).

people.name: Shallum
people.summary: One of the posterity of Judah (1 Chr. 2:40, 41).

people.name: Elishama
people.summary: Son of Jekamiah.

people.name: Mesha
people.summary: Heb. meysh’a, “deliverance,” the eldest son of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:42), and brother of Jerahmeel.

people.name: Rekem
people.summary: One of the sons of Hebron (1 Chr. 2:43, 44).

people.name: Shema
people.summary: Hear Israel.

people.name: Korah
people.summary: Leader of the famous rebellion against his cousins Moses and Aaron.

people.name: Shammai
people.summary: My name.

people.name: Raham
people.summary: Merciful, one of the descendants of Caleb, the son of Hezron (1 Chr. 2:44).

people.name: Caleb
people.summary: The son of Jephunneh (Num. 13:6; 32:12; Josh. 14:6, 14). He was one of those whom Moses sent to search the land in the second year after the Exodus.

people.name: Ephah
people.summary: 1 Chr. 2:46, a concubine of Caleb.

people.name: Gazez
people.summary: Mother of Haran.

people.name: Gazez
people.summary: Mother of Haran.

people.name: Haran
people.summary: The son of Caleb of Judah (1 Chr. 2:46) by his concubine Ephah.

people.name: Moza
people.summary: One of the sons of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:46).

people.name: Ephah
people.summary: 1 Chr. 2:47, a descendant of Judah.

people.name: Jahdai
people.summary: Grasper, a descendant of Caleb, of the family of Hezron (1 Chr. 2:47).

people.name: Jotham
people.summary: The sons of Jahdai.

people.name: Pelet
people.summary: A descendant of Judah (1 Chr. 2:47).

people.name: Shaaph
people.summary: Son of Jahdai.

people.name: Shaaph
people.summary: Son of Caleb.

people.name: Sheva
people.summary: The son of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:49).

people.name: Shobal
people.summary: One of the sons of Caleb, and a descendant of Hur (1 Chr. 2:50, 52; 4:1, 2).

people.name: Reaiah
people.summary: Son of Shobal.

places.name: Gilead
places.summary: Hill of testimony, (Gen. 31:21), a mountainous region east of Jordan. From its mountainous character it is called “the mount of Gilead” (Gen. 31:25).

places.name: Aram
places.summary: The son of Shem (Gen. 10:22); according to Gen. 22:21, a grandson of Nahor.

places.name: Geshur
places.summary: Bridge, the name of a district or principality of Syria near Gilead, between Mount Hermon and the Lake of Tiberias (2 Sam. 15:8; 1 Chr. 2:23).

places.name: Kenath
places.summary: Possession, a city of Gilead. It was captured by Nobah, who called it by his own name (Num. 32:42).

places.summary: Added from Digital Manna places-1283 (LPF sync 2026-10-13)

places.name: Madmannah
places.summary: Dunghill, the modern el-Minyay, 15 miles south-south-west of Gaza (Josh. 15:31; 1 Chr. 2:49), in the south of Judah. The Pal.

places.name: Hammath
places.summary: Warm springs, one of the “fenced cities” of Naphtali (Josh. 19:35).

places.name: Jabez
places.summary: A place inhabited by several families of the scribes (1 Chr. 2:55).
